# Coinio

> Coinio is a free, open-source (MIT) subscription and bill tracker (v0.4.0). Use the free hosted app at https://app.getcoinio.me (no ads, no tracking, encrypted EU backups) or self-host it as one Docker image with one SQLite file on your own server (VPS, home server, NAS, Raspberry Pi; amd64 and arm64).

Coinio keeps every recurring payment on one page: what is due this week, what is left to pay this month and what the year costs, converted into one main currency with daily exchange rates.

## Features

- Two ways to run it: free hosted cloud at https://app.getcoinio.me (email, passkey, Google or GitHub sign-in; export JSON any time) or self-hosted in one Docker container.
- Family & shared subscriptions: create a household, add member profiles with perspective-aware family roles (e.g. Mom, Dad, Partner, Child) or invite members via single-use links, split shared plans equally or by custom amounts, filter by "My share" or "Family total", while personal subscriptions stay private.
- Passwordless Passkey (WebAuthn) sign-in: sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a hardware security key on both app.getcoinio.me and self-hosted HTTPS installs.
- Two-way Firefly III integration: sync subscriptions ↔ bills and payments both ways, with a match preview on connect and a 2-day auto-payment delay to prevent duplicate transactions.
- Real billing cycles: weekly, monthly or yearly, every N cycles, charged automatically or paid by hand; mark paid, skip a period, pause.
- Calendar of due dates and reminders before anything renews, by email, Telegram, Discord, Slack, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, webhook or Apprise, with several reminders per subscription and editable message templates.
- Any ISO currency per subscription, including zero-decimal ones such as JPY and KRW; totals converted with daily European Central Bank reference rates (via Frankfurter).
- 161 built-in services with logos, categories and billing cycles; other sites get their own icon.
- Import from Wallos JSON (including Paid By mapped to household members) or Coinio's own JSON exports (including payment history); export to CSV or JSON.
- Built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) with OAuth at /mcp, so Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can list, add and update subscriptions.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: one-step iPhone Scriptable setup and cross-platform ScriptWidget package (iPhone, Android, Mac, Linux).
- Themes, accent colour, fonts, density, dashboard card order, custom CSS and sandboxed HTML cards.
- Interface in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

## Install (Self-Hosted)

- Script: `curl -fsSL https://getcoinio.me/install | sh` (checks for Docker, starts Coinio on port 8080, offers a Cloudflare Tunnel for https)
- Docker: `docker run -d --name coinio --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:8080 -v coinio-data:/data ghcr.io/getcoinio/coinio:latest`
- Also: Docker Compose, official Dokploy template (PR merged, one-click deploy coming soon), Unraid Community Applications, CasaOS, Portainer.
